critical_code_review_comments: App.js is a single 57-line file with everything inline (Home/Lookup/Console/Login/Shell) — should be split for maintainability, but not blocking.
Cookie is set with secure=True in auth.py — works fine behind HTTPS ingress; would break on plain-http local dev but not an environment we test.
meApi() rejection on first load produces a benign 401 console error on every logged-out page load. Consider swallowing 401 in /lib/auth.me() to avoid noisy console. Cosmetic only.
seed_staff_accounts is idempotent (skips existing) but does NOT rotate/update the password if STAFF_DEMO_PASSWORD changes. Acceptable per demo scope; flag if rotation needed.
